
{{alias}}( value )
    Returns the SGD classification penalty string associated with an SGD
    classification penalty enumeration constant.

    Parameters
    ----------
    value: integer
        Penalty enumeration constant.

    Returns
    -------
    out: string|null
        Penalty string.

    Examples
    --------
    > var out = {{alias}}(
    ... {{alias:@stdlib/ml/base/sgd-classification/penalty-str2enum}}(
    ... 'elasticnet' ) )
    'elasticnet'

    --------
